PRICING

One take rate. No subscription, no listing fee.

Loadbyton takes 6% of the agreed price on award — the same rate whether it's your first job or your five-hundredth. Volume lowers it through loyalty tiers, not negotiation.

01 / LOYALTY TIERS

Volume lowers the rate. Negotiation doesn't have to.

Three tiers, one mechanism — committed lane volume earns the lowest take.

TIER-01

Bronze

Every account starts here. — Standard take rate

  • Post or bid on any open load
  • Payment protection + live tracking
  • Standard 24h payout
TIER-02MOST POPULAR

Silver

Unlocked by volume. — Reduced take rate

  • Everything in Bronze
  • Priority support
  • Personal rate benchmark
TIER-03

Gold

Committed lane volume. — Lowest take rate

  • Everything in Silver
  • Contract-lane priority visibility
  • Fastest payout on POD
02 / WHERE IT GOES

Where the fee actually goes.

The take rate funds transporter verification, payment administration, dispute resolution, and the Lane Index data product — not a sales team cold-calling shippers. Freight amount passes through to the transporter; the platform only ever holds the fee.
